question: What consequence follows from abstaining from food during the day?
premises: There is abstention from food by day
Death from aging is the outcome
inference: By abstaining from food during the day, one will go to death from aging
uncertainties: The intended sense of gamiṣyate with vayo mṛtyuṃ is ambiguous; it may mean overcoming or undergoing age-death
plain_english: By abstaining from food during the day, one will go to death from aging.
